name: Craftsman's Writ: Free Action Potion
summary: A transferable writ asks you to deliver a Free Action Potion to a marked location. A trapped creature and scattered coins await there.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: A faded note requests a Free Action Potion and gives a delivery place and payment. The writ can pass from hand to hand, but you need it with you to complete the exchange.

sections.title: At the Marked Place
sections.body: At the marked spot, you find a creature thrashing inside a spider silk cocoon. It does not seem able to take the potion, and a handful of coins lies beside it.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ requests one Free Action Potion, with a delivery location and payment noted.

faq.q: Can I pass the writ to someone else?
aliases: can i give away the writ
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ can be transferred.

faq.q: What do I find at the marked location?
faq.answer: A creature trapped in spider silk is at the marked location, with coins scattered beside it.

faq.q: Why do I need the writ with me?
faq.answer: The writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
